reproductions.expectedFixedBehavior: Expired A1 dialogue must not be supplied as B2 current conversation.
Legitimate consecutive statuses must execute in capture order.
An expired pending answer must be revalidated and must not mutate its old call.
Stopped generations cannot issue late mutations or speech.
Cancellation must retire the intended dialogue, not become an old-call note.
Negations and questions must not produce the opposite mutation.
Keep the address separate and preserve both requested operations.
Read operations must speak the requested information, not a generic acknowledgment.
A whole CAD operation, including body consumption, must have a deadline.
A stalled voice response must not freeze processing and later execute stale work.
An answer immediately after a delivered question must retain its valid reply window.
Clarification must retain the original action and resolved task parameters.
Separate receipt from persistence and disclose failed, deferred or unconfirmed writes.
A contradictory incident reference requires clarification rather than a weak match.
